# Local English OCR data

`eng.traineddata` is from Tesseract's official `tessdata_fast` release 4.1.0:
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/tree/4.1.0

SHA-256: `7d4322bd2a7749724879683fc3912cb542f19906c83bcc1a52132556427170b2`

Apache 2.0 license is included in `LICENSE`. PyMuPDF uses this data locally; no document upload to a remote OCR/AI service is required. Override `OCR_TESSDATA_DIR` if deploying the data elsewhere. OCR-derived transaction figures require review before automatic financial alerts.
